# Friction slows things down

<!-- STEP id="slows" -->
When she stops pedalling, the bicycle slows down and stops. A ball you stop pushing does the same. Friction keeps acting against the motion.

To keep something moving at a steady speed, we must keep pushing, just to balance the friction.

<!-- STEP id="whatif" -->
What if there were no friction at all? How would things move then? Keep this question in mind.
